title: Name the failing and the hanging tests on Windows
goal: The bug's notes name each test that fails on Windows with its error line, and the test that hangs with the stack faulthandler dumped, from one local Windows run of python _tools/tests.py -v -o faulthandler_timeout=300.
notes: Needs a Windows machine. faulthandler_timeout is a built-in pytest option: it dumps every thread's stack when one test runs longer than the timeout, without a new dependency. The run is done and its results are in BG-ovulgaal's notes: 8 failing tests with their error lines and 3 causes, no hang, three slow tests with their stacks in TK-5vfbfjht. What remains is backlog.py done.
